messages:
june: Starting RC creation for release branch `release/2025-04-rc1`. Pushing tag `rc-2025-04-1` in a few mins. Release notes draft: https://go/redwood/releases/rc-2025-04-1. Change window is 02:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow. Need go/no-go + pin decision.

alex: +1 on the notes, skimmed. Any blocking migrations?

june: No DB migrations. One config flag toggle for `request_cache` behind feature flag — will keep off by default for this RC.

marco: For the dedicated customers we should pin the model to `rwd-model-v2.1-qat` in the release manifest. Can we confirm artifact SHA?

june: Artifact: `sha256:8f3a1b2c...` built by CI #8421. Will include in the manifest and pin.

opsbot: deploy-bot scheduled: canary deploy to prod-us-west-2 (1 node) at 2025-04-12T02:15:00Z. Artifact: rc-2025-04-1 (sha256:8f3a1b2c). Reply with `:confirm` to approve canary.

alex: :confirm

marco: :confirm — also adding a rollback tag `rollback/rc-2025-04-1` that points to `prod-stable` current SHA just in case.

june: Good call. I'll create the rollback tag and include rollback playbook link in release notes. Playbook: https://go/redwood/playbooks/rollback-rc.

opsbot: canary deploy started. Logs: ``[deploy] initiating canary on node i-0a1b2c3d``

deploy-bot: canary smoke tests: health-checks OK, p99 latency within SLO, sample outputs look sane. Marking canary as SUCCESS.

tess: Nice. Did we run the prompt regression suite? Any quality regressions vs current prod model?

june: Ran the regression harness earlier — no significant regressions on the baseline prompt set (delta < 0.5% top-line metric). Full results attached in the release notes.

marco: Given canary success, I vote to promote to prod during the window. Recommend staged traffic shift: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds and automated health checks.

alex: Agree. Also set auto-fallback to `prod-stable` model if error rate > 0.5% or latency > 2x SLO.

june: I'll update rollout policy in the manifest: `staged: [10,50,100], hold_minutes: 15, fallback: prod-stable`.

opsbot: Promotion scheduled at 2025-04-12T02:30:00Z. Will perform staged traffic shift as configured.

deploy-bot: promotion started. Step 1: 10% traffic to rc-2025-04-1. Monitoring...

deploy-bot: step completed. Metrics: error_rate 0.02%, p95 latency +3%. Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: step completed. Metrics stable. Proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: promotion COMPLETE. All traffic on rc-2025-04-1.

tess: Congrats. I'll update the customer-facing release notes and post in #announcements after the audit log is attached.

marco: Created rollback tag `rollback/rc-2025-04-1` pointing at `sha256:5b7c9d0e` (prod-stable). Rollback command: ``git push origin rollback/rc-2025-04-1:refs/tags/rc-2025-04-1 && opsbot trigger-rollback rc-2025-04-1``

june: Marking thread resolved. Anything else before close?

alex: Add a short blurb for the postmortem checklist: confirm metrics retention and eval snapshots persisted.

june: Added. Closing. :white_check_mark:
